NOT ONLY THE GREATEST RUNNING WEEKEND, BUT THE GREATEST WEEKEND OF THE YEAR JUST ONE HOUR FROM NOW. WE EXTEND OUR DEEPEST APPRECIATION TO OUR PUBLIC SAFETY PARTNERS WHO SUPPORT MAKE IT POSSIBLE TO HOST THE BOSTON MARATHON EACH YEAR. THEIR PROFESSIONALISM AND DEDICATION ARE VITAL TO ENSURING A SAFE AND SUCCESSFUL EXPERIENCE FOR ALL THE EXTENSIVE PLANNING AND COORDINATION CARRIED OUT OVER MANY MONTHS BY THESE AGENCIES DOES NOT GO UNNOTICED. IT IS GREATLY VALUED BY ME, THE BOSTON ATHLETIC ASSOCIATION TEAM AND OUR ENTIRE RACE COMMITTEE. THANK YOU FOR ALL YOU DO AND FOR EVERYTHING THAT YOU DO TO CONTRIBUTE IN THE DAYS AHEAD. ADDITIONALLY, WHAT YOU DO ON A DAILY BASIS THROUGHOUT THE YEAR TO MAKE US FEEL SAFE AND SECURE IS ALSO GREATLY APPRECIATED. BECAUSE OF YOUR WORK, WE ARE ABLE TO DO WHAT WE DO AND THE RUNNERS AND THE ATHLETES ARE ABLE TO DO WHAT THEY DO. THANK YOU. I’D ALSO LIKE TO EXTEND MY APPRECIATION TO THE MEMBERS OF THE MEDIA. JOINING US TODAY FOR YOUR CONTINUED COVERAGE OF THE BAR AND BOSTON EVENTS THROUGHOUT THE YEAR. FOR THE ATTENTION YOU BRING TO THE MANY EVENTS AND ACTIVITIES HAPPENING OVER THE NEXT FOUR DAYS. Up to $1.48M in prize purse for 130th Boston Marathon Updated: 3:51 PM EDT Apr 17, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Elite athletes from around the world will be racing for their share of more than $1.48 million in prize money during this year's edition of the Boston Marathon.That includes money for the top 10 finishers in the open and wheelchair divisions for the men and women. Boston Marathon coverage: How to watch | Race forecast | Find Your FinishFor the wheelchair racers, the first-place men and women earn $50,000, and they can also win an additional $50,000 if they set a course record. Second place is worth $30,000, and third is worth $15,000. For the open division runners, the top prize is $150,000, along with the opportunity to earn the $50,000 course record bonus. Second place earns $75,000, and third place earns $40,000. Prize money is also available for other competitive divisions, including masters and several para-athletics divisions. The Boston Marathon is set for Monday, April 20. WCVB is the exclusive broadcast partner of the race and the Boston Athletic Association. It happened Monday morning in the San Fernando Valley community of Pacoima, California. Video shows a low-flying plane strike a power line, triggering a small explosion, before plummeting about 30 feet to a parking lot below. According to officials with the Los Angeles Fire Department, a 70-year-old man was flying the Cessna 172.After striking the power line, the plane nosedived into an O'Reilly’s auto shop parking lot below.Local news outlets report that the plane was returning to the nearby Whiteman Airport at the time of the crash. The pilot, who was the only person in the plane, was taken to a nearby hospital for treatment. His condition is unknown.No additional injuries were reported.Officials with the Federal Aviation Administration say the crash is under investigation. World’s oldest nun celebrates 113th birthday, has four words of advice Updated: 3:31 PM EDT Apr 22, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Born in 1913, a New York nun has just celebrated her 113th birthday.Sister Francis Dominici Piscatella celebrated her milestone birthday Sunday, declared the world’s oldest nun by Guinness World Records. Piscatella has spent more than 90 years serving the Catholic Church, joining the Dominican order when she was 17. Above video: Study confirms being grateful may help you live longerThe Long Island native has been a member of the Sisters of St. Dominic of Amityville since 1931. Through her decades of service, Piscatella served as a teacher, taking on various subjects in Catholic schools across the area until she retired at 84. In fact, teaching is the secret to longevity, according to Piscatella."Teach until you die," she told the New York Post in 2025, when asked about her secret to a long and healthy life.“You have to be a saint before you get to heaven,” she said.Piscatella has seen 10 different popes in her lifetime. And in celebration of her 113th birthday, Pope Leo XIV issued a proclamation celebrating her milestone birthday, according to WABC-TV in New York.Piscatella has held the title of the world's oldest living nun for a little over a year now, according to Guinness World Records.She became the oldest nun after the death of Brazil's Sister Inah Canabarro Lucas on April 30, 2025.
